notes:
Background: mid-market B2B productivity SaaS. Heavy usage: interactive in-app chat for power users + search across customer docs. Evaluated Hosted API first (fast onboarding) but need predictable latency and data isolation for enterprise customers. Team emphasized: 
- POC criteria: p95 chat latency <250ms for default routes, 99.9% availability for live support flows, cost target ~ $0.50-$1.50 per 1k active users/month (rough proxy).
- Workload mix: 60% chat (short-turn interactive), 25% doc-search/embeddings, 15% batch reranking for recommendations.
POC ask: setup Dedicated reserved pool (small), run canary at 10% traffic for 2 weeks. Canary config: route 10% of US West users to Dedicated pool + model variant A (quant-8) for cost/latency baseline; rest remain on Hosted API model variant B (opt-16 hosted).
Fallback & routing plan (requested by eng lead):
- Primary: Dedicated (US-West) serving model-variant-d (quant-8 tuned).
- Canary fallback: if p95 latency >300ms OR error rate >1% for 5m, automatic routing to Hosted API model-variant-b in US-East.
- Region failover: if Dedicated region degraded (sustained >5% dropped requests over 10m), traffic automatically route to Hosted API in US-East; EU traffic pinned to Hosted/EU or Dedicated/EU depending on residency label.
- Rollback plan: automated canary monitoring via Redwood Console metrics + Slack alert. If health checks fail for 3 consecutive 5m windows, immediate rollback to last stable model (hosted fallback) and AE + SE notified. Manual rollback steps documented in Drive SOW draft.
Model preferences: prefer open models (Llama 2 family variants, MPT) or Redwood-curated open checkpoints; willing to test quantized 4/8-bit variants for cost. Key is deterministic latency and consistent quality for user-facing flows.
Security: require SSO/SAML integration, KMS for encryption-at-rest keys, SOC2 evidence, audit logs forwarded to customer's SIEM. Data residency: EU enterprise customers require EU residency; Redwood Dedicated must support VPC with private networking.
Commercial: procurement wants 12-month reserved capacity pricing + overage tiers. AE shared draft pricing deck (Drive: /decks/emerald-bridge/pricing-v2.pdf).
Stated quotes from CTO: "We need predictable latency for support workflows — can't have inconsistent tails when traffic spikes."
Notes from SE: "Focus POC on p95/p99, token cost per session, KV cache hit-rate. We'll instrument prefix cache and batching thresholds during canary."
